messages.author: 702f6b2d3e501d01
messages.subject: Question about nested mapreduce
parts:
Hi all,
when I execute the following code, I got a error message in Chinese, I translated it: error of input(), no arguments v and no default value.
it is appreciated if anyone could give me some comments on that. thanks. 

seg <- mapreduce(
  input = "/user/superman/senti/weibo-data.txt",
  input.format=make.input.format("csv", encoding="UTF-8", quote = "\"", fill = TRUE,comment.char = "",sep = "\t",stringsAsFactors=TRUE),

  map <- function(k,v) {
mb_id = as.character(v[[1]])
post = as.character(v[[2]])
keyval(mb_id,post)
}
)


senti=mapreduce(
  input=seg ,
  output = "/user/superman/senti/output1",
  output.format=make.output.format("csv",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,fileEncoding="utf-8",append=TRUE),
  map = function(k,v) {
keyval(k,v)
}
)

Hi Antonio,
Thanks for your feedback. 
let me clarify my question, I saw the script in your presentation as bellow, I try to run it, but it failed with error.
mapreduce(input = 
  mapreduce(input = "pv_users",  
    map = function(k, v) keyval(v['userid'], v['gender']), 
    reduce = function(uid, genders) 
      lapply(unique(genders), function(g) keyval(NULL, g)),
  output  = "pv_gender_sum",
  map = function(x, gender) keyval(gender, 1)
  reduce = function(gender,counts)             keyval(k,sum(unlist(counts)))

So I decide to write it by myself, but it failed again, as I have not much knowledge about how to write nested mapreduce, so I post the previous question. I just want to know how to write a nested mapreduce, thanks very much.
